examples.name: reference
examples.title: Members, several, from a list in hand

examples.name: empty
examples.title: Single, empty and required, with a placeholder

body: <sf-lookup id="l1" label="Members" name="members" multiple max-items="2" hint="People"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"options": [{"value": "u1", "label": "Anna Petrova", "caption": "Design", "avatar": {"initials": "AP"}}, {"value": "u2", "label": "Boris Ivanov", "caption": "Development", "avatar": {"initials": "BI"}}, {"value": "u3", "label": "Vera Smirnova", "caption": "Support", "avatar": {"initials": "VS"}}, {"value": "u4", "label": "Gleb Orlov", "caption": "Sales"}], "exclude": ["u4"], "value": [{"value": "u1", "label": "Anna Petrova", "caption": "Design", "avatar": {"initials": "AP"}}]}</script></sf-lookup>

<sf-lookup id="l2" label="City" name="city" required value='{"value":"kazan","label":"Kazan"}'><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"options": [{"value": "kazan", "label": "Kazan"}, {"value": "moscow", "label": "Moscow"}, {"value": "samara", "label": "Samara"}]}</script></sf-lookup>

checks.title: the search box is a combobox named by the label, controlling a listbox, described by the hint

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('l1'); const i = el.querySelector('input'); const list = document.getElementById(i.getAttribute('aria-controls')); const label = document.getElementById(i.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')); const hint = document.getElementById(i.getAttribute('aria-describedby')); return i.getAttribute('role') === 'combobox' && i.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && list.getAttribute('role') === 'listbox' && list.getAttribute('aria-multiselectable') === 'true' && label.textContent.trim().startsWith('Members') && hint.textContent.trim() === 'People'; })()

checks.title: the form sends one entry per chosen value, the values alone

steps.check: (() => { const d = new FormData(document.getElementById('f')); return JSON.stringify(d.getAll('members')) === '["u1"]' && d.get('city') === 'kazan'; })()

checks.title: an excluded value is never offered; a choice adds a chip, says input then change once, the list stays open

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('l1'); window.__said = []; el.addEventListener('input', (e) => window.__said.push('input:' + e.detail.action)); el.addEventListener('change', (e) => window.__said.push('change:' + e.detail.action)); el.querySelector('input').focus(); return el.search('o'); })()
steps.check: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('l1'); const rows = [...el.querySelectorAll('[role=option]')]; return rows.length === 3 && rows.every((r) => !/Gleb/.test(r.textContent)) && el.querySelector('input').getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true'; })()

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('l1'); const row = [...el.querySelectorAll('[role=option]')].find((r) => /Boris/.test(r.textContent)); row.click(); return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('l1'); return JSON.stringify(el.value.map((v) => v.value)) === '["u1","u2"]' && JSON.stringify(window.__said) === '["input:added","change:added"]' && el.querySelectorAll('sf-tag').length === 2 && el.querySelector('input').getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true'; })()

checks.title: past max-items a choice is refused with a visible polite line, the value unchanged

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('l1'); el.querySelector('input').focus(); el.search('o'); return true; })()

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('l1'); const status = el.querySelector('[role=status]'); return el.value.length === 2 && status.getAttribute('aria-live') === 'polite' && status.textContent.trim() === 'No more than 2'; })()

checks.title: a chip's remove button is named Remove <label> and removes it, said as removed

steps.check: (() => { const tag = document.querySelector('#l1 sf-tag'); const button = tag.querySelector('button'); return Boolean(button) && button.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Remove Anna Petrova'; })()
(() => { const el = document.getElementById('l1'); return el.value.length === 0 && el.querySelectorAll('sf-tag').length === 0; })()

checks.title: single: a choice is the value, commits and closes the list, the box shows its label

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('l2'); el.querySelector('input').focus(); return el.search('mos'); })()

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('l2'); const i = el.querySelector('input'); return el.value.value === 'moscow' && el.value.label === 'Moscow' && i.value === 'Moscow' && i.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && new FormData(document.getElementById('f')).get('city') === 'moscow'; })()

checks.title: a form reset puts the value attribute back and says nothing

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('l2'); el.value = {value: 'samara', label: 'Samara'}; window.__said2 = 0; el.addEventListener('input', () => { window.__said2 += 1; }); el.addEventListener('change', () => { window.__said2 += 1; }); document.getElementById('f').reset(); return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('l2'); return el.value.value === 'kazan' && el.querySelector('input').value === 'Kazan' && window.__said2 === 0; })()

checks.title: required and empty: value-missing; a value makes it valid

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('l2'); return el.value === null && el.validity.valueMissing === true && document.getElementById('f').checkValidity() === false; })()
(() => { const el = document.getElementById('l2'); return el.validity.valid === true && el.value.label === 'Moscow'; })()

checks.title: below min-length the hint and no call; then the provider's answer; unavailable is one neutral line

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('l3'); window.__calls = []; el.provider = async (query, {limit}) => { window.__calls.push(query + ':' + limit); return query === 'zz' ? {status: 'unavailable'} : {items: [{value: 1, label: 'Ann ' + query, caption: 'QA'}]}; }; el.querySelector('input').focus(); return el.search('a'); })()
steps.check: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('l3'); return window.__calls.length === 0 && el.querySelector('[role=status]').textContent.trim() === 'Type at least 2 characters'; })()

(() => { const el = document.getElementById('l3'); const row = el.querySelector('[role=option]'); return JSON.stringify(window.__calls) === '["an:20"]' && row && /Ann an/.test(row.textContent) && /QA/.test(row.textContent); })()
(() => { const el = document.getElementById('l3'); return el.querySelectorAll('[role=option]').length === 0 && el.querySelector('[role=status]').textContent.trim() === 'Search is unavailable'; })()

checks.title: the words follow the page language; the host's aria-label names the box

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('l4'); el.provider = async () => ({items: []}); el.querySelector('input').focus(); return el.search('a'); })()
steps.check: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('l4'); const text = el.querySelector('[role=status]').textContent.trim(); return el.querySelector('input').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Person' && text.length > 0 && !/Type at least/.test(text); })()
